## Structure and components

- [statement] The registry record for NCT07174310 lists an estimated enrollment of 900 and a primary outcome of time to confirmed motor progression event on MDS-UPDRS Part III score, with a time frame of up to at least Week 104. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT07174310 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines
- [statement] VacSYn (NCT06015841) is a Phase 2 trial of the active anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy ACI-7104.056; AC Immune states Part 1 randomized 34 patients 3:1 to ACI-7104.056 or placebo. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://ir.acimmune.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ac-immune-positive-interim-phase-2-data-aci-7104056-support · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06015841

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] PADOVA is a Phase 2b, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group study in which individuals with early-stage PD on stable symptomatic monotherapy (levodopa or MAO-Bi) receive intravenous prasinezumab 1500 mg every 4 weeks. (medium confidence) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39798255/ · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2024-12-19
- [statement] Roche reports that in a pre-specified analysis the effect of prasinezumab in PADOVA was more pronounced in the population treated with levodopa (75% of participants), with HR=0.79 and a nominal p=0.0431. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-06-16) — https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2024-12-19 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2025-06-16
- [statement] AC Immune reports that in the interim Phase 2 VacSYn analysis ACI-7104.056 induced a 100% responder rate, and at week 76 serum antibody titers were over 500-fold higher than in the placebo group. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-12-11) — https://ir.acimmune.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ac-immune-positive-interim-phase-2-data-aci-7104056-support · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The Lancet's Department of Error notice states that the appendix of the PADOVA article has been corrected as of July 2, 2026. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-02) — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0140673626013012 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] In PADOVA, the primary endpoint of time to confirmed motor progression was not met: Roche reports HR=0.84 and p=0.0657, and the Lancet paper reports a non-significant delay in motor progression with prasinezumab versus placebo. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-05-30) — https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2024-12-19 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0140673626008652

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The Lancet PADOVA paper describes prasinezumab as a humanised monoclonal antibody that binds the C-terminus of aggregated forms of α-synuclein. (medium confidence) — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0140673626008652 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2024-12-19
- [statement] The Lancet paper's interpretation states that although PADOVA did not meet the primary endpoint, prespecified exploratory evidence suggests clinical activity of prasinezumab, supporting continued investigation in the phase 3 PARAISO trial (NCT07174310). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-05-30) — https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0140673626008652 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT07174310
- [statement] Roche announced its decision to proceed with Phase III development of prasinezumab, and a Michael J. Fox Foundation news page described the drug as moving into the Phase III stage of clinical trials. (high confidence) (verified as of 2025-06-17) — https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2025-06-16 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://www.michaeljfox.org/news/drug-potential-slow-or-stop-parkinsons-moves-next-phase-clinical-testing
- [statement] The registry record lists NCT07174310 (PARAISO) with phase PHASE3, overall status RECRUITING, an ACTUAL start date of 2025-11-24 and an ESTIMATED primary completion date of 2029-06-30. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT07174310 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0140673626008652
- [statement] A Nature Medicine analysis compared the PASADENA open-label extension with an external comparator cohort from the PPMI observational study; the authors describe it as an exploratory analysis that requires confirmation in future studies. (high confidence) — https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-024-03270-6 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2024-12-19
- [statement] In the phase 2 SPARK trial of the anti-α-synuclein antibody cinpanemab, the authors report the trial was stopped after the week 72 interim analysis owing to lack of efficacy, with 357 participants enrolled. (medium confidence) — https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35921450/ · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines · also: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38315945/
- [statement] The registry record lists NCT06015841 with overall status ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, an ESTIMATED enrollment of 150 and an ESTIMATED primary completion date of 2028-06. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-27) — https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies/NCT06015841 · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines
- [statement] AC Immune reports that total CSF a-syn levels stabilized in the ACI-7104.056 arm while decreasing in the placebo group (post-hoc analysis p=0.018), and describes clinical measures of motor symptoms as a trend for stabilization. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-12-11) — https://ir.acimmune.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ac-immune-positive-interim-phase-2-data-aci-7104056-support · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines
- [statement] In an interview published by the Michael J. Fox Foundation, Kenneth Marek of the Institute for Neurodegenerative Disorders said results from the PADOVA Phase II study were far less clear, and potentially encouraging, though more research is needed. (low confidence) — https://www.michaeljfox.org/news/news-context-mixed-results-two-experimental-drugs-targeting-alpha-synuclein · keywords: Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines

## Research summary — Anti-alpha-synuclein immunotherapy: prasinezumab and vaccines

Prasinezumab binds aggregated alpha-synuclein; its PADOVA trial in early-stage Parkinson's disease did not meet the primary endpoint, and a Phase 3 trial is registered as recruiting. Cinpanemab's SPARK trial was stopped for lack of efficacy. AC Immune's active vaccine ACI-7104.056 is in Phase 2, with sponsor-reported interim biomarker trends.
